note: Current-season MLB lines lifted verbatim from the eephus.io leaderboards. This site derives no wRC+ and no xFIP of its own, so neither is served here: HEM+ is the offense-rate index it does compute and FIP / SEM+ / REM+ are the run-prevention numbers.
